name: AgentFeedback
technicalDescription: Structured right/wrong feedback on the receipts agents, given in the receipts panel: on the reader (BankFileReader) per extracted line or field, on Nina (CollectionsAgent) per checked line. No agent replies to it. A טעה row with valueCorrect is a ready eval golden. AgentFeedbackStats counts it per agent and week.

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: Bank line (text link to BankLines.bankLineId); empty for feedback on the whole file

columns.name: field
columns.description: Field that was wrong, e.g. amount, payerName, valueDate, customer, invoices

columns.name: comment
columns.description: Free note (also the file's comment thread)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
